description: This file defines the 'ThingDeleteModel' class used for deleting 'Thing' entries in a MongoDB database. It creates a model that updates a document to mark it as deleted by setting a 'delete at' timestamp.

classes.name: ThingDeleteModel
classes.description: A final immutable class representing a MongoDB update model for deleting a 'Thing' by setting its delete timestamp.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of ThingDeleteModel from Metadata.

methods.name: toMongo
methods.description: Converts the delete model into a MongoDB WriteModel that updates the document to mark it as deleted.
